name: pnp-copilot-pro-dev-mcs-procode-vs-lowcode-comparison
title: Pro-Code vs Low-Code Comparison - Multi-agent decision support
shortDescription: A Copilot Studio multi-agent orchestrator that triggers a pro-code and a low-code child agent in parallel and merges their analysis into one comparison report.
longDescription: Organizations repeatedly have to choose between a pro-code and a low-code approach when building a solution, and that choice affects development speed, total cost of ownership, scalability, governance, and the skills the team needs. This Copilot Studio sample answers that question with a multi-agent pattern: an orchestrator triggers a pro-code child agent and a low-code child agent in parallel with the same question, then merges their responses into a single structured report containing two comparison tables, a verdict with justification, levers to improve the weaker option, and an executive summary.
